Refined the changelog timeline, search, and mobile controls. Added SEO metadata, sitemap coverage, and consent-aware ads. Redesigned homepage and blog artwork, workspace previews, and navigation; polished the favicon and FAQ.

Improved SEO, homepage copy, artwork, and responsive workspace previews. Refined homepage changelog and navigation. Balanced Focused lyrics and translations within measured glyph bounds; improved Live Lyrics ad-lib clearance. Fixed empty Group Chat messages, fitted bubbles to wrapped content, centered notification text and timestamps, and smoothed equalizer animation across frame rates.

Improved homepage previews and mobile navigation. Kept the Vault preview to 12 cards and hid its scrollbar. Fit Live Scroll artwork and auto-followed active lyrics. Added consistent artist colors. Refined Group Chat bubbles, translations, and pronunciation. Put PlanetMusic first in browser and social titles. Refined the Contact hero and moved support and privacy links beside the introduction. Fixed split-ad-lib punctuation crashes. Preserved credits on white gradient ad-libs. Matched wrapped bubbles to lyric and pronunciation bounds. Anchored new Group Chat entries above the typing footer. Glided older rows by arrival height and composited visible chat elements to reduce jitter.

Split player logic into focused modules. Added verified Deezer playback and source handoff. Cached ARL checks. Preserved Group Chat history and refined lyric rendering. Improved long-lyric wrapping and motion settings. Refined homepage and changelog previews. Added prerendered, consistently styled /docs legal pages. Added About Me content and a Terms last-updated date. Auto-loaded the sample Vault on first visit. Temporarily hid the ad-choice popup. Centered homepage footer links on mobile.

Added selective song export and optional settings, Deezer ARL, and blog posts. Added an import preview with song selection and merge-safe updates. Refined backup modals and added a backup guide. Updated homepage feature cards and artwork; reshaped the six-step guide with responsive arrows.
